questions.question: Describe the structure of a ball-and-socket joint.

questions.question: Describe the paranasal air sinuses.
questions.solution_html:

questions.question: Apply the knowledge of respiratory muscles to explain breathing movements.
questions.solution_html:
• Apply knowledge of respiratory muscles to explain breathing movements. / A)
  •  Inspiration: diaphragm contracts; external intercostals raise ribs
  •  Forced expiration: internal intercostals & abdominal muscles
questions.final_answer:  Forced expiration: internal intercostals & abdominal muscles

questions.question: Describe the gross anatomy of lungs and their lobes.
questions.solution_html:
•  Right lung: 3 lobes
  •  Left lung: 2 lobes + cardiac notch
  •  Apex, base, hilum

questions.question: Identify the anatomical location of the pancreas in relation to the duodenum and / stomach.

  •  Head in C-loop of duodenum
  •  Body behind stomach
  •  Tail near spleen

questions.question: Explain the functions of the autonomic nervous system.
questions.solution_html:
•  Controls involuntary activities
  •  Sympathetic → fight/flight
  •  Parasympathetic → rest/digest

questions.question: Describe the structure and functions of the spinal cord.

questions.question: Describe the types of movements possible at synovial joints with suitable / examples.
questions.solution_html:
• / U)
  •  Flexion/Extension – elbow
  •  Abduction/Adduction – hip
  •  Rotation – atlas-axis
  •  Circumduction – shoulder
  •  Gliding – intercarpal joints
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the types of bones based on shape with examples.
questions.solution_html:
•  Long – femur
  •  Short – carpals
  •  Flat – scapula
  •  Irregular – vertebra
  •  Sesamoid – patella
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the gross and microscopic structure of the lungs.
questions.solution_html:
• Gross: lobes, fissures, hilum, pleura
  • Microscopic: bronchi → bronchioles → alveoli; type I & type II pneumocytes;
  • capillaries
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the flow of blood through the heart .
questions.solution_html:
•  SVC/IVC → RA → tricuspid → RV
  •  Pulmonary artery → lungs
  •  Pulmonary veins → LA → mitral → LV → aorta
questions.final_answer:  Pulmonary veins → LA → mitral → LV → aorta
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the cranial nerves and their functions.
questions.solution_html:
•  I smell, II vision
  •  III/IV/VI eye movements
  •  V mastication, facial sensation
  •  VII facial expression
  •  VIII hearing & balance
  •  IX/X swallowing & autonomic
  •  XI shoulder movement
  •  XII tongue movements
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the parts of the stomach and their functions.
questions.solution_html:
•  Cardia – entry
  •  Fundus – gas storage
  •  Body – mixing
  •  Pylorus – regulates emptying
  •  Secretes HCl, mucus, enzymes
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the structural importance of pancreatic islets.
questions.solution_html:
•  Islets contain α, β, δ, PP cells
  •  Endocrine: insulin, glucagon, somatostatin
  •  Rich vascularity → rapid hormone release
  •  Maintains glucose homeostasis
  • (4×5 = (20 marks))
